title: EEG: Visual Working Memory in Acute TBI
description: EEG recordings from a visual working memory task in healthy controls and individuals with sub-acute mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI), with mind wandering probes inserted between trials. Participants were tested across up to three sessions, from 3-14 days post-injury to roughly 4 months later, with MRI acquired only in the first session. Data were collected in 2016-2018 and have not been published in a dedicated paper.
methods_description: Participants performed a visual working memory task programmed in Matlab, with mind wandering probes between trials. Session 1 took place 3-14 days post-injury, Session 2 about 2 months later, and Session 3 about 4 months later. Data were collected at the Center for Brain Recovery and Repair, UNM Health Sciences Center. EEG data are preprocessed and analysis scripts are included.
